title: Subassistants: a project-scoped Assistant in a pinned first tab that Tally delegates to

requirements.text: Every project's tab strip has a pinned first tab for its Subassistant, styled visibly differently from session tabs
requirements.check: eye: relaunch, open a project, the first tab is the Subassistant and looks distinct

requirements.text: A Subassistant's overview, sweep, tell, open and close act only on its own project; naming another project refuses
A session's reply to something a Subassistant told it goes back to that Subassistant, not to Tally
requirements.check: node tests/run.mjs (relay sender case) + swift test routing case pass

requirements.text: When a project has a Subassistant, Tally's tell to that project goes to the Subassistant, and the Subassistant's reply comes back to Tally
A Subassistant runs on records only like Tally (no project file reads) and starts on a fresh conversation at each project status update
requirements.check: swift test: SessionLaunch arguments for a subassistant carry the records-only rule; eye: Status update in a project restarts it fresh

text: Tally delegates to a project's Subassistant: Tally -> Subassistant -> sessions, replies flow back up the same way
Subassistant is records-only like Tally: overview, sweep, tell; no reading project files
Subassistant is a pinned first tab in the project's tab strip, visibly different from session tabs
user_said: pinned first tab, but needs to show visually differently.
